headline: Recommended $23,547,692 for Roberts accelerated repairs; approved outside review of hiring and personnel protocols.
summary: Missituk Elementary and Brooks Elementary accelerated repairs can now move forward under a construction manager at risk process. A first reading passed for a school calendar policy that treats Lunar New Year and Orthodox Good Friday as excused absences. Members also approved a press release supporting the Medford High School building project.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including an $18,815.17 Medford Educational Foundation donation, 7-0.
Approved hiring an outside reviewer for up to $30,000 to review hiring and personnel protocols, 7-0.
Recommended the City Council approve $23,547,692 for the Roberts accelerated repair program, 7-0.
Approved the construction manager at risk approach for the Missituk and Brooks accelerated repairs.
Approved the first reading of revised school calendar policy IC, and waived the second reading.
Approved a press release supporting the Medford High School building project.
Approved a resolution directing the facilities and capital planning subcommittee to review capital projects and update the plan.
discussion: Outside hiring review: Members asked how a reviewer would get access to records and whether the results would be shared publicly. Speakers from the public asked that the review cover harm to students and communication with families.
Special education entry plan: Members asked for measurable goals, a timeline, and a clearer picture of progress over time.
MCAS results: Members questioned reading and math scores for students with disabilities and asked for a follow-up report.
